notes: Streams with 1..23 vertices (count 0 is malformed: the original loops without a guard), random words and texture shifts with junk upper bits, random stream state and texture selector 0 or the flat data selector. The vertex loader 0xc48dc logs ESI/ECX and the first source dword; the polygon builders 0xd2500/0xd2584/0xd2634/0xd2704/0xd2a7c/0xd2d7c log ESI/ECX, the first indices, shade mode, depth, shade selector, FS and colour mode; 0xfc9f8 logs EAX. The saved escape ESP at 0x159064 is compared as guest RAM.
